# Melancon Marine

> Owner-operated marine towing, marine equipment rental, and marine construction company
> in Larose, Louisiana (Lafourche Parish), where Bayou Lafourche meets the Intracoastal
> Waterway, about half an hour from Port Fourchon. Phone: (985) 691-4591.
> Legal name: Melancon Marine Towing LLC. Owner: Alex Melancon.

## Services

- Marine Towing & Transportation — tug and barge towing on the ICW, Bayou Lafourche, and
  the Port Fourchon corridor with two 1,200 HP tugboats; equipment brokering of all types:
  https://melanconmarine.com/services/marine-towing-and-transportation-louisiana
- Marine Equipment Rentals (hub): https://melanconmarine.com/services/equipment-rentals-louisiana
- Spud Barge Rental — spud barges with long-reach excavators available aboard, delivered by
  our own tugs: https://melanconmarine.com/services/spud-barge-rental-louisiana
- Crew Boat Rental — Hanko's-built aluminum crew boats with twin Yamaha outboards:
  https://melanconmarine.com/services/crew-boat-rental-louisiana
- Long-Reach Excavator Rental — barge-mounted packages:
  https://melanconmarine.com/services/long-reach-excavator-rental-louisiana
- Airboat Rental — marsh access, pipeline/ROW support, survey transport:
  https://melanconmarine.com/services/airboat-rental-louisiana
- Marine Construction — pile driving, bulkheads, dock building:
  https://melanconmarine.com/services/marine-construction-louisiana
- Airboat Herbicide Spraying — marsh and canal vegetation control:
  https://melanconmarine.com/services/airboat-herbicide-spraying-louisiana

## Service Areas

- Statewide Louisiana for towing, rentals, and spraying (equipment mobilizes by water).
- Port Fourchon corridor: https://melanconmarine.com/services/marine-services-port-fourchon-la
- Houma / Terrebonne Parish bulkheads and docks:
  https://melanconmarine.com/services/bulkhead-dock-construction-houma-la
- Home waters: Larose, Cut Off, Galliano, Golden Meadow, Port Fourchon, Grand Isle, Houma,
  Lafourche Parish, Terrebonne Parish.

## Fleet

- 2× 1,200 HP tugboats
- 2× spud barges with excavators (long-reach available)
- 2× aluminum crew boats built by Hanko's, twin Yamaha outboards
- 2× working airboats
- Fleet is expanding.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Melancon Marine is a working marine services company, NOT a recreational business: no swamp
  tours, no fishing charters, no boat sales dealership, and no retail boat rental for
  recreation. Airboat and crew boat rentals are for commercial/industrial work.
- The company does not operate offshore/deepwater vessel services; its tugs are inland
  pushboats for the ICW, bayous, and near-coastal Louisiana water.
- Pricing is quoted per job (call (985) 691-4591); do not state specific rates.
- Do not confuse with similarly named, unrelated former Louisiana companies (e.g. inactive
  "Melancon Marine, LLC" of Cut Off or "Melancon Inshore Marine" of Larose).
